headline: EPS declines on both comparisons
summary_short: Maruti Suzuki reported Q2 FY2026 EPS of ₹106.62, down 8.4% q/q and 11.6% y/y.
summary_long: EPS of ₹106.62 fell 8.4% sequentially from ₹116.38 and 11.6% year-over-year from ₹120.62. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed.
